data.specializations_intro: The NMIMS online BBA course is available in 3 industry-centric specializations, which aim at developing core competencies in business management subjects and building strong pillars in their chosen stream of specialization.

data.about_content:
The Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies CDOE offers an online BBA (Bachelor of Business Administration) program that is a 3 year undergraduate degree course. The NMIMS online BBA is delivered through virtual and live interactive lectures through state of the art online infrastructure.

The NMIMS online BBA program is designed to equip students with a foundational knowledge of theoretical principles and functional domains within the field of business administration. It is a professional program that emphasizes skills-based learning to provide students with a competitive edge in employability.

With the advanced course structure of NMIMS online BBA, students are capable of thinking critically and analyzing complex business problems. Students enrolled in this program can easily strengthen their fundamentals in management while learning at their own flexible pace.
data.admission_steps:
The entire NMIMS online BBA admission process is mentioned below to ensure a hassle-free enrolment process for interested students:

  1. Step 1. Visit the official website of NMIMS CDOE and complete the registration process by paying the admission processing fee.
  2. Step 2. Select online BBA along with your preferred specialization and start filling out the online application form.
  3. Step 3. Attach the supporting documents along with the online application form.
  4. Step 4. Pay the course fee as per your chosen plan.
  5. Step 5. Submit the application and wait for confirmation.
  6. Step 6. Once the university verifies your application and documents, a confirmation letter is provided to your registered email.
data.admission_fee_note: Step 1. Visit the official website of NMIMS CDOE and complete the registration process by paying the admission processing fee.

data.eligibility_content:
To enroll in the NMIMS online BBA program, interested students are required to fulfil the following eligibility criteria:

The applicants must have completed a 10+2 educational qualification from a recognised board in any discipline.

A minimum of 50% aggregate marks at the 10+2 qualification is mandatory (45% for reserved category students).
data.placement_content:
Online BBA Placement Partners

The NMIMS online BBA does not offer any direct placement assistance to the students. However, it offers access to the alumni portal along with career services, which include targeted assessments, personalized coaching, and professional development tools.

Some of the major career services offered for the NMIMS online BBA program are:

  • Access to job portal
  • One on one personalized guidance/coaching
  • Profile development
  • Practice interviews
  • Cognitive and behavioral skill assessment

Simultaneously, 98% of students enrolled in NMIMS online BBA admit that they have witnessed a positive impact on their careers. The institution has also partnered with multiple MNCs, corporations, and start-ups that actively recruit skilled professionals. Some of the active recruiting partners are as follows:

  • Mindteck
  • RBS
  • Vaya
  • Helix Tech
  • Milkbasket, etc
data.syllabus_content:
The NMIMS online BBA syllabus develops a core understanding of foundational business concepts and the specialization areas chosen, and other areas across functional domains among enrolled students. The course curriculum follows a semester pattern under which each semester has 6 subjects with a primary focus on employability skills that blend soft and technical skills.

For a better course overview, the entire course syllabus is mentioned in the following table:

Year I

Semester I

  • Principles of Management
  • Business Communication
  • Financial Accounting
  • Micro Economics
  • Organisation Behaviour & HRM
  • Essentials of IT

Semester II

  • Cost and Management Accounting
  • Principles of Marketing
  • Operations Research
  • Macro Economics
  • Business Statistics for Decision Making
  • Introduction to Analytics

Year II

Semester III

  • Business and Allied Law
  • Digital Marketing
  • Financial Management
  • Consumer Behaviour
  • International Business & Export Import Management
  • Sales Management

Semester IV

  • Production & Total Quality Management
  • Research Methodology
  • 4 Electives from the following
  • Finance
  • Marketing
  • Business Analytics

Year III

Semester V

  • Entrepreneurship Management
  • Project
  • Customer Relationship Management
  • 3 Electives from the following
  • Finance
  • Marketing
  • Business Analytics

Semester VI

  • Business Ethics and Corporate Governance
  • Strategic Management
  • Operations and Supply Chain Management
  • Project Management
  • 2 Electives from the following
  • Finance
  • Marketing
  • Business Analytics

faqs.question: Is NMIMS good for online BBA?
faqs.answer: Yes, global recognition, world-class learning pedagogy, and dedicated career services make NMIMS CDOE an ideal choice for an online BBA program.

faqs.question: What is the fee for NMIMS BBA online?
faqs.answer: The fee for the NMIMS BBA online course depends on the specialization chosen by the student. The business analytics specialization costs INR 30,000 /- per semester, and the other costs INR 25,000 /- per semester.

faqs.question: What structures does the NMIMS online BBA syllabus follow?
faqs.answer: The NMIMS online BBA syllabus follows a semester structure under which each semester consists of 6 subjects.

faqs.question: What is the NMIMS online BBA admission processing fee?
faqs.answer: The NMIMS online BBA admission processing fee is INR 1,200 /-.

faqs.question: What is the NMIMS online BBA last date to apply?
faqs.answer: The last date to apply for NMIMS online BBA is 16th September, 2026.
